name: studio-evolve
description: Self-evolving ontology pipeline — grow a compiled clife-onto-engine ontology from its own runtime trajectories. Four stages after studio-ontology: ground (anchor every IR entry to a probe query over real data), simulate (derive labelled competency cases from rules / actions / links), attribute (locate the divergence point of failed trajectories and attribute it to a five-element deficit, emitting atomic IR edit proposals), verify (dual-gate sandbox check on source cases + resampled held-out cases, scored on three growth axes: taller / sturdier / wider). Accepted proposals re-enter ontology-compile in modify mode; nothing is merged without passing both gates and a human look.
